modmenu.summaryTranslation.make_bubbles_: Makes bubble particles pop and lets them rise to the water surface.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.make_bubb:
This client-side mod makes bubble particles pop and lets them realistically rise to the water surface. 
It also adds bubble particles to opening chests, opening barrels and explosions underwater.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.make_bubb:
This client-side mod makes bubble particles pop and lets them realistically rise to the water surface. 

It also adds bubble particles to opening chests, opening barrels and explosions underwater.
make_bubbles_pop.config_lib.missing.desc: Make Bubbles Pop requires %s to be installed for in-game configuration. Would you like to download it now?
make_bubbles_pop.config.title: Make Bubbles Pop Configuration
make_bubbles_pop.config.POP_PARTICLE_ENA:
Default: §aON§f 
§dℹ Note:§f Make sure to disable this or Particle Tweaks' implementation if Particle Tweaks is installed.
make_bubbles_pop.config.POPPED_BUBBLES_M: └ Maintain bubble velocity for bubble pop particles
make_bubbles_pop.config.BUBBLE_PHYSICS_E:
Enables overhauled bubble physics when colliding with blocks or entities. 
Default: §aON§f 
§dℹ Note:§f This does not currently work for bubbles from soul sand or magma blocks.
make_bubbles_pop.config.BUBBLE_LIFETIME_:
The time it takes for a bubble to pop underwater. 
By default, this is set longer than in vanilla to allow bubbles to reach the water surface. 
Default: §b32§f §7(Vanilla: 8)§f
make_bubbles_pop.config.BIOME_COLORS_ENA:
Tints all bubble types depending on the water color. 
Default: §aON§f
make_bubbles_pop.config.CHEST_BUBBLES_EN:
Default: §aON§f 
§dℹ Note:§f Make sure to disable this or Effective's implementation if Effective is installed.
make_bubbles_pop.config.CONTAINER_SOUND_: └ Enable sound when opening chests or barrels underwater
make_bubbles_pop.config.EXPLOSION_BUBBLE:
Default: §aON§f 
§dℹ Note:§f Make sure to disable this or Explosive Enhancement's implementation if Explosive Enhancement is installed.
